outcome: Professor read-only supervision view for student Experiments
owner_impact: Professor accounts can see active student/researcher Experiments in a separate Professor surface, open them in the Lab, inspect and run them, while the student's canonical Experiment remains read-only. Student-to-student privacy and owner-only mutation remain enforced by Supabase RLS.
